gaps.sentence: 'I'll pay for the damage,' he said. He ___ pay for the damage.
gaps.explanation: 'I'll pay' as a voluntary act is reported with 'offered to pay'.

gaps.sentence: 'Shall I close the window?' he asked. He asked ___ close the window.
gaps.explanation: Shall I...? (offering) becomes if/whether he should... in reported speech.

gaps.sentence: 'We won't stay long,' they said. They said they ___ stay long.
gaps.explanation: will not → would not (wouldn't) after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: 'Don't forget to lock up,' my mother said. My mother reminded me ___ up.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't forget' corresponds to remind + object + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'You broke my phone!' she said to her brother. She ___ her brother of breaking her phone.
'Leave the building immediately!' the firefighter ordered. The firefighter ordered us ___ the building immediately.
gaps.explanation: Orders are reported with order + object + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'I can swim,' the boy boasted. The boy boasted that he ___ swim.
gaps.explanation: Can backshifts to could in reported speech.

gaps.sentence: 'We've been waiting for hours,' the passengers complained. The passengers complained that they ___ waiting for hours.
gaps.hint: present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous
gaps.explanation: have been waiting → had been waiting after the past reporting verb 'complained'.
